name: Salary
description: Commercial salaries from employer disclosures, with Adzuna's predictions kept separate. Mirrors v_commercial_salary_clean and Phase 3 #1.

cards.text:
## Salary
**Source:** `v_commercial_salary_clean`: Adzuna postings with salary_quality = ok, USD, annual. Federal pay bands are disclosed by law and not shown here.

**Mirrors:** Phase 3 #1 (docs/phase_3_findings.md). Headline numbers are **employer-disclosed only**; Adzuna-predicted salaries appear solely in the separate comparison card and are never blended into one number. Data window: see the right.

cards.title: Data window
cards.description: First and last UTC snapshot date in the database and the n behind this dashboard (disclosed and predicted rows counted separately).

cards.title: Disclosed salary distribution ($10k bins)
cards.description: Employer-disclosed annual salary midpoints only (salary_is_predicted = false), with n per bin.

cards.title: Disclosed median salary by seniority, with n
cards.description: Disclosed only. seniority is instrument-limited (title-only); 'no title signal' is its own group. p25/p75 beside the median; small_n flags groups under 10.

cards.title: Comparison: Adzuna-predicted vs employer-disclosed
cards.description: Side by side, split by salary_is_predicted, never blended. Predicted figures are Adzuna's model estimates; use them only for this comparison, never as 'the' salary.
